messages:
anika: Quick spike report 
I watched 5 new users on the empty "Start a project" screen. They treated the sample row like decorative thumbnails and didn't click. Some tried the keyboard shortcut '?' hoping for help.

ryan: That's interesting 
Maybe the thumbnails need clear affordances like a hover overlay 'Preview' and a small badge 'Starts in 1 click' so users know it's actionable.

kofi: A11y note 
Screen reader users require clear text links inside each card; the image alone isn't enough. Also ensure each card has aria-describedby pointing to the short summary so SRs can read the intent.

sara: Copy nit: avoid "sample" across product. Consider "starter" or "template". 'Starter project' seems clearer. For the explainer, suggest: "Get a runnable demo with prompts and a demo endpoint." Keep under 90 chars.

anika: Proposed minimal iteration: add 'Import starter project' primary button, include three cards with 'Preview' overlay buttons, add small 'Or create an empty project' tertiary action, and update screen-reader labels. Keep visuals minimal so we can ship quickly.

ryan: Also if we add an inline micro-tutorial link 'Get set up in 3 steps' that opens a lightweight side-sheet, we can reduce churn for users who want guided flow. Instrument whether they use the sheet or import immediately.

kofi: Implementation checklist for a11y: buttons inside cards must be reachable by tab, preview overlays must be accessible via keyboard, aria-labels for preview buttons like 'Preview Starter: Echo Chatbot', and side-sheet role=dialog with focus management.

anika: Action items: anika to finalize copy for quick mock, ryan to prototype hover overlay + badge states, kofi to write acceptance criteria for automated a11y checks. I'll create the task ticket.

onboarding-bot: Task created: PRO-3501 "Quick ship: starter-import affordance + preview overlays" assigned to anika/ryan/kofi. Due 2026-03-30.

anika: Shipping note: aim for progressive enhancement so if JS disabled, the cards degrade to links that go to detailed sample pages.

ryan: Thx, will include that in prototype.
